scope: native Grainfield editor binding to StateStore host gesture callbacks

test.case: Grainfield bound editor knob emits a host automation gesture
test.command: ./build/Grainfield-editor-test \"Grainfield bound editor knob emits a host automation gesture\" --reporter compact

proven: The actual Grainfield editor creates and binds its Density PanelKnob.
A real knob mouse-down/drag/up lifecycle writes the Density StateStore value.
The binding brackets that lifecycle with one begin and one end gesture for parameter 1.
not_proven: No external DAW was used in this focused test.
The StateStore callback is the framework seam consumed by format adapters; this receipt does not claim a host-specific AU, VST3, CLAP, or AAX automation event was observed.
Standalone editor host gesture/state/audio receipts remain unavailable in the current host matrix.

status: editor-to-parameter gesture path proven; external-host automation receipt remains open
